subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Someone taken a prisoner to fulfil demands
solution:
The correct answer is **'hostage'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• ***Dealer-** Someone who purchases and maintains an inventory of goods to be sold*
 
• ***Guest- **A visitor to whom hospitality is extended*
 
• ***Host- **A technical name for the bread used in the service of Mass or Holy Communion*
 
• ***Hostage- **A prisoner who is held by one party to insure that another party will meet specified terms*
 
 
 
• Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
